{"explanation":"A Gregorian leap year is divisible by 4, except years divisible by 100 are not leap years unless they are also divisible by 400. The function takes a single integer, performs only arithmetic checks (no mutation of inputs), and uses the modulo operator, which works correctly for negative years too since the result is compared to 0 (e.g., -4 % 4 is -0, and -0 === 0 is true).","code":"function solve(year) {\n  return (year % 4 === 0 && year % 100 !== 0) || year % 400 === 0;\n}"}
